title: Public Repository Secret to Crown Jewel S3 Data Exfiltration
summary: An attacker leverages a committed AWS key in repository staging config to assume overprivileged IAM role and exfiltrate customer PII from S3.

steps.description: Attacker extracts AWS credentials from git history in config/staging.env.
Attacker authenticates via CLI and assumes overprivileged StagingDeployer role.
Attacker dumps sensitive customer PII records from s3://customer-pii-vault-prod.
